p: In accordance with Law 34/2002 (LSSI), the website owner's details are:
This website describes our hospitality and beauty staffing services in Barcelona and lets you send a request.
The owner is not liable for misuse of the website's content or for linked third-party websites.
Spanish law applies. Disputes are handled by the courts of Barcelona unless the law provides otherwise.
Business form: name, business name, role, WhatsApp number. Purpose: contacting you about your request and finding staff.
Candidate form: name, WhatsApp number, profession. Purpose: keeping your contact in our candidate database and offering you vacancies.
Your consent (Art. 6.1.a GDPR), given by ticking the checkbox. You can withdraw it at any time.
Business requests: for the duration of our relationship plus legal periods. Candidate contacts: 12 months.
Data is not shared with third parties except processors: Telegram (manager notifications), Google (request spreadsheet), Cloudflare (hosting).
Access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and objection (ARSULIPO) at hello@smenabcn.com. You can complain to the AEPD (www.aepd.es).
This site sets no advertising or analytics cookies. Visit statistics are collected without cookies or personal data.
Campaign parameters (UTM) are kept in sessionStorage until you close the tab, to attach them to your request. Spam protection (Cloudflare Turnstile) may use technical browser data.
If we add advertising pixels, they will only load after your consent in a banner.
